description.value: Everyday Sushi is a Japanese fast-food spot on West 10th Avenue in Vancouver's west side, serving a broad menu of maki rolls, nigiri, sashimi, aburi oshi, poke bowls, and party trays available for quick pickup. The menu explicitly labels vegetarian and vegan items, and the selection of rice bowls and banh mi rounds out options for cyclists with varied dietary needs. Its location near UBC makes it a convenient refuelling stop on routes through the west side.
